segments.text: JUST now, with great joy, I received your welcome letter, I fear the post will be gone, ere this can be put in. Blessed be GOD, I am a little better. I have a fine commodious house, and am kept from much company. You will certainly know my rout. Indeed and indeed, I long to see my dear Mr. K――――n, and my dear Mr. H――――y. Stand, my friends, and insist upon my not being brought out into action too soon. The poor old shattered bark hath not been in dock one week, for a long while. I scarce know what I write. Tender love to all.
